blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Thousands of Filipino families are expected to visit cemeteries and travel to their home provinces on the eve of Undas to pay tribute to their departed loved ones, as authorities intensify security and traffic management operations.
Airports, seaports, bus terminals and major roads are also bracing for increased passenger and vehicle volume ahead of All Saints’ Day and All Souls’ Day.
Follow our live updates for the latest developments on cemetery activities, crowd levels, traffic conditions and public safety measures as the country observes Undas 2026./dp
